Bill.BriefDescription: Requiring that antifreeze be made unpalatable to humans and animals.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to placing aversive agents in antifreeze; andadding a new section to chapter 70.106 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 70.106 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) Any antifreeze product containing by weight ten percent or moreethylene glycol and manufactured or sold in this state on or after July1, 2004, must also contain an aversive agent, approved by the director,in a concentration sufficient to render that antifreeze productunpalatable to humans and animals. (2) If the director finds or has probable cause to believe that anyantifreeze product being sold in this state fails to comply withsubsection (1) of this section, the director is authorized to orderthat product's removal from retail shelf space.
